question: How many sections does the IELTS Listening test have and how long does it take?
expected_answer: Toi khong the xac minh thong tin nay tu nguon hien co.

answer: The IELTS Listening test has one section and it takes approximately 30 minutes, plus an additional 10 minutes to transfer your answers to an answer sheet [S1].
